entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MSBuild property values containing '/dotnet' are silently dropped, causing MSB1009 #53662
  • [Known Build Error] ProjectUpdateInProcTests.ProjectAndSourceFileChange_AddProjectReference timing failure #53661
  • [Known Build Error] BackCompatibilityPublish_Hosted_Works fails with file lock on .gz compression temp #53660

Closed

  • CRUD dotnet commands for MSBuild properties #7500
    Backlog
  • `dotnet tool exec` and `dnx` don't work if `dotnet-tools.json` happens to reference the same tool #53357

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix reporting Hot Reload capabilities of WASM projects #53665
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview3] Copy HotReload dll to intermediate to avoid duplicate identity in multi-client WASM #53664
    backport
  • Fix MSBuild property values containing '/dotnet' misinterpreted #53663
    Area-CLI
  • Exclude all VB CodeAnalysis assemblies from crossgen globally #53659
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix `dotnet tool exec` / `dnx` failing when tool exists in `dotnet-tools.json` but not yet restored #53658
    backport
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Fix `dotnet tool exec` / `dnx` failing when tool exists in `dotnet-tools.json` but not yet restored #53657
    backport
  • Copy HotReload dll to intermediate to avoid duplicate identity in multi-client WASM #53656
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53655
  • Split compilation handler #53652

Merged

  • [dotnet-watch] Fix WebSocket transport crash on Ctrl+R restart #53648
  • [dotnet-watch] Add device selection support #53631
  • dotnet test MTP: Disable ANSI output in LLM environments #53654
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #53653
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53650
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53651

Updated

  • Use OTel for telemetry #53181
    Area-CLI
  • Merge dotnet/templating source into dotnet/sdk (Phase 1: history-preserving migration) #53647
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix GenerateDepsFile "An item with the same key has already been added" when project name matches a dependency reference assembly name #53450
  • Enable /graph in CI builds, dev builds, and PR builds #53607
  • Improve support of nuget commands with file-based apps #53535
    Area-run-file
  • Warn when a vulnerable or EOL SDK version is resolved #53557
    Area-Infrastructure, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Only download runtimes for referenced frameworks #53518
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53611
  • Migrate 5 MSBuild tasks to IMultiThreadableTask (Group 2: Bundle, Deps, Config & Hosts) #52936
  • Warn for missing shebang #53614
    Area-run-file
